The '''Er'Kit system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]. It was situated on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] passed through it on the way to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Er'Kit system was a part of several Imperial factions, including the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], and eventually the system was [[Battle of the Er'Kit system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.

==Description==
The Er'Kit system was located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Borgo Prime system|Borgo Prime]] and [[Storinal system/Legends|Storinal systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also linked it to the [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The Er'Kit [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the terrestrial<ref name="Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'Kit/Legends|Er'Kit]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
===Republic and Empire===
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] including the Er'Kit system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the final phase of the [[New Sith Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], the system was a part of the territories unaligned with or contested by the two factions. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Er'Kit system was situated within Republic-controlled space,<ref name="TEA" /> and the Republic's [[Ninth Army|Ninth Sector Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the system's vicinity during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Er'Kit system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> The Er'Kit system fell within the borders of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

[[File:DeathStar1-SWE.png|thumb|left|300px|The Death Star battlestation traveled through the Er'Kit system on its path to Alderaan.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a pair of vessels involved with the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] traveled through the Er'Kit system. First, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], having [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] of the Rebel-aligned [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], above the Outer Rim world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], traveled through Er'Kit with the captive senator aboard in order to rendezvous with the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the Outer Rim's [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]]. Shortly after that, when [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], decided to demonstrate its offensive capabilities upon the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] cleared the hyperlanes for the mobile [[Space station/Legends|station]] to move to its target unhindered, traveling through the Er'Kit system on its path.<ref name="TEA" />

===Post-Endor===
The Er'Kit system lay within the territory of the Empire's [[Oversector Outer]] in the immediate aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], but advances by the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] against Imperial splinter factions in the wake of that engagement resulted in the [[Oversector/Legends|oversector's]] boundaries having receded from the system [[6 ABY/Legends|two years]] later. Er'Kit was nevertheless situated within [[Imperial Space]] between [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and, by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], specifically was located within the borders of the Imperial-controlled territory consolidated during Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic in the [[9 ABY/Legends|preceding year]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:ErKitYuuzhanVongAttack-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|The Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Er'Kit system.]]
The Er'Kit system fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Reunification|reorganized]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], but, once again, an [[Imperial Skirmishes|offensive]] by the New Republic&mdash;which saw its forces, as well as a secondary movement of Imperial ones, pass through the system prior to a [[Battle of Ketaris (17 ABY)|confrontation]] in the [[Ketaris system/Legends|Ketaris system]]&mdash;left the system outside the boundaries of the former government by [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Er'Kit system|conquered]] the Er'Kit system between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and the system remained under the invaders' [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Er'Kit was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE" /> At least [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|one]] Er'Kit had traveled into the wider galaxy<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|odymandrell|Mandrell, Ody}}</ref> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="32BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which include the appearance of [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Galactic Empire, the planet was also home to a family that included<ref name="Warlords" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Humans" /> brothers and future Imperial Navy [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Treuten]] and [[Kosh Teradoc]].<ref name="Warlords" /> By 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="22BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:4:4," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic,<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}}</ref> and the population of the Er'Kit system around 25 ABY numbered between one and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Er'Kit, and therefore its [[Star/Legends|star]] system, was introduced on a map included in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] named the system and placed it in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the Er'Kit system.<ref name="AoI" />
